messages.content: What is a vector database? one sentence

A vector database is a specialized data store that indexes and retrieves high‑dimensional vector embeddings (e.g., from machine‑learning models) using similarity search algorithms such as approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) to enable fast, semantic queries over large collections of unstructured data【1†source】.
